name: Block
lead: One block the game version has, in its own numbers, from `game.block(name)`: hardness, light, fire and material.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.description: The rule Citadel runs for it, such as "grass", "flowing", "torch" or "falling"; nil for a block that does nothing on its own.

fields.name: hardness
fields.description: Seconds-scale hardness in this version's numbers; below zero is unbreakable.

fields.name: random_ticks
fields.description: Whether the random-tick pass acts on it.

fields.name: opaque
fields.description: Whether it is an opaque full cube, which is not the material's question.

fields.name: light
fields.description: What it gives off, 0..15, and what a step through it takes away.

fields.name: light_filter
fields.description: What a step through it takes off the light, 0 to 15.

fields.name: resistance
fields.description: The three the block-update tables own: nil in a game that has none.

fields.name: flammability
fields.description: Fire's two numbers: how readily it catches and how fast it burns away. Nil in a game with no block-update tables.

fields.name: material
fields.description: The jar's Material as five questions; nil in a game with no block-update tables.

fields.name: drops
fields.description: The one field a pack writes. Whether a block of this kind that the world breaks by itself leaves its item: true leaves it on a lite world too, false never, nil is the world's default. Reads what this pack set.
